current_simple_21.description: Current language inventory excluding the three affricate/complex units ts, c=/tʃ/, j=/dʒ/, which the current 111-cell GlottoDelta chart cannot score as standalone segments.

no_schwa_20.description: Current simple inventory with contrastive schwa removed.

latin17.description: Five-vowel Latin-compatible base without /v z ʃ/ and without complex affricates.

latin17_yw.description: Latin-compatible base plus the two globally common glides /j w/.

lexical22_yw.description: Five vowels, current simple consonants, plus /j w/; intended for soft-contrast production experiment.

grammar6.description: Statistical micro-core candidate for grammar-critical material.

grammar8.description: More useful grammar-critical core while retaining very high coverage.
